name: Data Alteration Black
text:
(This card is always treated as a 'Datashaper' card)
Target 2 Cyberse Monsters you control, declare a level from 1-8, until the End Phase both mosters become the declared level, then immediatly after this effect resolves, you can Xyz summon a Cyberse Xyz Monster using those targetd monsters and/or other Cyberse monsters as XYz Materials. If a Special Summoned Cyberse Monster you control is destroyed, you can shuffle 1 Xyz Monster from you GY into the Extra Deck, then set this card, but banish it when it leaves the field.
